Thanks for the reschedule options — I'll join on Wed 02/10 at 13:30 PT (Neha, please book). For prep, let's align on three asks to land during the QBR:

3) Expansion ASK: recommend a 6-month pilot for embedding-based rerank on one product line (projected +12% retrieval precision) — we should have an ROI slide ready.

Neha — can you include a single-slide ROI forecast and the sample optimization checklist when you send the calendar invite? Pete — if procurement has a DocuSign or PO cadence we should know it in advance; otherwise we'll bring standard renewal paperwork.
